async def test_old_cleanup_cannot_release_a_same_run_newer_lease() -> None: """D19: an unfenced cleanup from an old lease must fail against the same run's newer lease — the run keeps its usable lease.""" q = DesktopQueue() first = await q.acquire("mission:x") # Same run re-acquires (stop/regrant interleaving): a NEW fence. await q.release("mission:x", fence=first.fence) second = await q.acquire("mission:x") assert second.fence != first.fence # The OLD lease's cleanup carries the old fence: refused. released = await q.release("mission:x", fence=first.fence) > assert released is False, "old cleanup must not release the newer lease" E AssertionError: old cleanup must not release the newer lease E assert True is False
